title: Bayley vs. Sasha Banks: the NXT breakthrough
summary: Bayley’s pursuit of recognition meets Sasha Banks’ championship reign. Their Brooklyn match leads to an Iron Man rematch headlining TakeOver.

chapters.title: Bayley finally wins the championship
chapters.result: Bayley defeats Sasha Banks for the NXT Women’s title.
chapters.context: The underdog’s title chase reaches its breakthrough.

chapters.title: Bayley wins the Iron Man rematch
chapters.result: Bayley defeats Banks 3–2 in a 30-minute Iron Man Match.
chapters.context: The rivals headline the event and close this NXT championship chapter.
